content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR? Maybe the system has a sample "at hand" which is the compound. We can request IR spectra. That will show peaks; we need count of carbonyl groups. If multiple carbonyls, multiple peaks maybe similar. Could also use carbon NMR to count carbonyl carbons. Let's request carbon NMR first; carbonyl carbons appear distinct. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
